name: codex-project-flow
description: Install and safely upgrade a schema-13 Codex workflow using default model settings, a renewed hub on apply, a separate planning chat, and preserved local plan and state memory.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap, upgrade, and reconcile a permanent project workflow.
interface.longDescription: Initializes a permanent hub and separate planning chat. Every task reads PROJECT_PLAN and PROJECT_STATE; meaningful progress and user acceptance persist locally. Natural-language archive requests distinguish continuation, pause and ambiguity. Upgrades preserve project memory; chat actions require the native task tools.
defaultPrompt: Use $bootstrap-project-flow in this saved local project to install the workflow and adopt this task as its permanent hub.
Use $upgrade-project-flow from a task inside the target project to apply a task-aware upgrade with current-project isolation and empty-snapshot fail-closed recovery.
